d5e34ba54f56b89718b2c6e849407bb3dedf3f8d.summary: Dutch national police (Politie) news item, published 13 November 2025, reporting that Operation Endgame disrupted the infostealer Rhadamanthys, the remote access trojan VenomRAT and the Elysium botnet. The police say these malware types infected hundreds of thousands of victims worldwide. They describe Operation Endgame as started in 2022 and as the largest international operation against ransomware and cybercrime.

d575a6482d9b8e691b7033592928e91ae53c2aa1.summary: InQuest blog post (December 2021) on an ongoing Dridex campaign that delivers malware through password-protected Microsoft Excel spreadsheets containing macrosheets. Lures included a fake CDC COVID-19 form, a fake resume, fake spreadsheets, and impersonation of NPD Group's DecisionKey software, plus emails with team memos and numeric passwords. The post reports an uptick on December 15 and a multi-stage download via an embedded script, with payloads hosted on Discord CDN servers. Payload identifiers were withheld. The post also promotes InQuest's email attack simulation.
